text: Tarag is a spontaneously fermented Mongolian milk in which Lactobacillus dominates (L. delbrueckii in pyrosequencing, L. helveticus and Lc. lactis among isolates), alongside yeasts such as Galactomyces. Its flora varies with region and with the animal the milk comes from.
